 Jabodetabek Weather Friday 13 November: Jakarta and Bekasi Potentially Rained 
 13 November 2026, 06:15 | Editorial Team 
 Tim VOI 
 Reporter 
 Advento C Saudale 
 Editor 
 Illustration of rain (ANTARA) 
 Share:
 JAKARTA - A number of areas in Jakarta, Bogor, Depok, Tangerang, and Bekasi (Jabodetabek) have the potential to be hit by rain on Friday, November 13. The Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) predicts that moderate intensity rain may occur in West Jakarta, South Jakarta, Bekasi City, and Depok City.
 In the DKI Jakarta area, light rain is predicted to occur in the Thousand Islands and East Jakarta. Meanwhile, Central Jakarta and North Jakarta are predicted to be cloudy. West Jakarta and South Jakarta have the potential to experience moderate intensity rain.
 The air temperature in Central Jakarta is estimated to range from 25-31 degrees Celsius, North Jakarta 26-30 degrees Celsius, West Jakarta 25-31 degrees Celsius, South Jakarta 25-32 degrees Celsius, and East Jakarta 25-33 degrees Celsius. Meanwhile, the Thousand Islands are in the range of 28-30 degrees Celsius.
 Moving to the Bogor area, light rain has the potential to rain on Bogor Regency with an air temperature of around 24-32 degrees Celsius. Meanwhile, Bogor City is predicted to be cloudy with a temperature of 23-31 degrees Celsius.
 In Depok City, rain has the potential to fall with moderate intensity. The air temperature is estimated to be in the range of 24-32 degrees Celsius. The public in this area is urged to anticipate weather changes, especially in the afternoon and evening.
 Meanwhile, the Tangerang Raya area is predicted to experience varying weather. People in the cities of Tangerang, Tangerang Regency, and South Tangerang need to monitor the BMKG forecast updates because the details of weather conditions and temperatures for each region have not been fully confirmed.
 For the Bekasi area, light rain is predicted to occur in Bekasi Regency with a temperature of 25-34 degrees Celsius. Meanwhile, Bekasi City has the potential to experience moderate rain, with an air temperature of around 24-33 degrees Celsius.
 BMKG urges the public to remain vigilant against weather changes, especially residents who are active in areas with moderate rain potential. Motor vehicle drivers are advised to reduce speed when it rains and maintain a safe distance because slippery roads can increase the risk of accidents.
